claim_a.statement: The PSC is a bounded complex of elements with maximal integrated information; elements outside this boundary (e.g., cerebellar neurons, peripheral sensory/motor pathways, basal ganglia loops) do not directly contribute to consciousness despite influencing cortical activity.

claim_b.statement: The locus of conscious processing is a large-scale prefrontal-parietal (and cingulate/temporal) cortical network, not posterior sensory cortices alone.
